reviews.title: A good upgrade from the H-610i
reviews.comment: I upgraded from an H610-i to this B760M-ITX and have been very pleased so far. I originally wanted to upgrade just for the WiFi that exists on the I/O, but there are other great features not seen on cheaper boards. The I/O, while being limited (most mini ITX boards are), is good and usable. It has 2 USB 2.0 ports, but also has 2 USB 3.2 ports and a USB C port. As mentioned previously, it also has WiFi built into the I/O that performs much better than the USB WiFi adapter I previously used. The headers on the board are much more accessible and easy to use. Also, the CPU power connector near the top left of the motherboard is in probably the easiest to access location I have seen on a mini ITX board.  The M.2 slot is also accessible with good speeds. The boot speed is good, the BIOS has plenty of features, is easy to use, and works out of the box. It was immediately compatible with my 12th gen CPU. It feels well built and durable, and for the price I think it is a good option. If I were to build another computer with a 12/13/14th gen GPU, I would definitely recommend spending a little extra money on this board over cheaper options.
reviews.author: bart

reviews.title: Good board trade some features for better price
reviews.comment:
Nice motherboard for a good price. Asrock always does a good job with motherboards in my experience.
Went from a Z370 to the B760 it isnt as feature packed but it gets the job done and looks nice doing it. NVME on top of board made things easier. Using with a 12600KF (also on sale).
Playing around in BIOS now seeing what I can do with it but don't want to push to hard with only 5 VRMs.
Asrock had a pre-installed driver updater after everything was put together so dont have to worry about any of those. Just overall nice board where you exchange some top tier features for lower price. I'd buy again
reviews.author: Dan

reviews.title: Great motherboard at a fair price
reviews.comment: This motherboard worked right out of the box without having to update the bios or anything to get it going. Every part was recognized and everything is running smoothly in my new build. It did everything I needed it to do and the price was pretty good. It fit perfectly in my M-ITX media center case. I would definitely order another ASRock board again in the future.
reviews.author: Bilbo Baggins

reviews.title: Perfect, but 1 critical flaw makes it unworthy
reviews.comment: Perfectly functional, but once you place your RAM in and it's seated, the clips are extremely flimsy and RAM for reason seats in extremely snug, the clips will break if you try to remove it, so if you buy this motherboard, assume you're never replacing your RAM
